commit_message: Add ADR0156 campaign controls to AI Studio
pr_body:
## Summary

Adds the first-release AI Studio campaign controls on top of the validated ADR 0156 core: exact installed candidate selection, seven-task plan selection, repetition/profile controls, explicit Run Benchmark consent, persisted progress, pause/stop/resume drift checks, aggregate reporting, and an exact Download & Run review boundary delegated to the ADR 0155 managed-runtime owner.

The existing manual benchmark recording path remains available. Campaign execution uses a dedicated controlled-fixture adapter in the next change on this same Draft PR; this UI change does not route benchmark work through the active private project.
